blocks.title: Después de este pdf sabrás
bullets: construir frases con varias subordinadas sin que pierdan claridad
usar construcciones absolutas (The work done, we went home.)
expresar concesión con much as, however much, be that as it may

blocks.text: Una construcción absoluta (absolute construction) tiene su propio sujeto y un participio, como en español Terminado el trabajo, nos fuimos a casa. Son formales y literarias.

head: Inglés
Español
rows: The work done, we went home.
Terminado el trabajo, nos fuimos a casa.
Weather permitting, the match will be played.
Si el tiempo lo permite, se jugará el partido.
All things considered, it was a success.
Teniéndolo todo en cuenta, fue un éxito.
He sat there, his eyes closed.
Estaba allí sentado, con los ojos cerrados.
There being no further questions, the meeting ended.
Al no haber más preguntas, se levantó la sesión.

head: Palabra
Ejemplo
Español
rows: whatever
Whatever you decide, I'll support you.
Decidas lo que decidas, ...
whoever
Whoever wins, it will be a great game.
Gane quien gane, ...
however + adjetivo
However hard I try, I can't do it.
Por mucho que me esfuerce, ...
wherever
Wherever you go, you'll find tourists.
Vayas donde vayas, ...
whenever
Call me whenever you like.
Llámame cuando quieras.
no matter what / how
No matter what happens, stay calm.
Pase lo que pase, ...

blocks.title: Decidas lo que decidas = whatever you decide
blocks.text: El español repite el verbo en subjuntivo: decidas lo que decidas, vayas donde vayas, gane quien gane. El inglés usa una sola palabra y el presente normal: whatever you decide, wherever you go, whoever wins. Después de however el adjetivo va justo detrás: however hard (por mucho que), however much (por mucho que, cueste lo que cueste).

head: Estructura
Ejemplo
Español
rows: much as
Much as I like him, I can't trust him.
Por mucho que me caiga bien, ...
however much
However much it costs, we'll buy it.
Cueste lo que cueste, ...
try as I might
Try as I might, I couldn't open it.
Por más que lo intenté, ...
for all
For all his money, he isn't happy.
A pesar de todo su dinero, ...
be that as it may
Be that as it may, we must decide.
Sea como sea, ...

items: Pon el sujeto y el verbo cerca; los añadidos largos, mejor al final.
No uses más de dos subordinadas en una frase; si no, mejor dos frases. El inglés tolera mucho menos que el español las frases muy largas.
Repite el sujeto si la frase es larga: The committee, which met three times last month, has decided ...
Usa comas alrededor de las partes explicativas, y ninguna alrededor de las especificativas (B1 · pdf 5).

rows: However I try hard, I can't do it.
However hard I try, I can't do it.
however + adjetivo justo detrás.
What you decide, I'll help you.
Whatever you decide, I'll help you.
Decidas lo que decidas = whatever you decide.
Much as I like him, but I can't trust him.
Much as I like him, I can't trust him.
much as y but no van juntos.
The work was done, we went home.
The work done, we went home.
Construcción absoluta: participio sin was.
Who wins, it will be exciting.
Whoever wins, it will be exciting.
Gane quien gane = whoever wins.

blocks.text: Completa con la palabra que falta. Las respuestas están en la última página.

items.full: Whatever you do, don't tell her.

items.q: ______ hard I work, I never finish on time.
items.full: However hard I work, I never finish on time.
Wherever you go, I'll follow you.

items.q: ______ wins the election will face a difficult task.
items.full: Whoever wins the election will face a difficult task.

items.q: ______ as I like her, I don't agree with her.
items.full: Much as I like her, I don't agree with her.
Weather permitting, we'll have a barbecue.

items.q: The decision ______, we went out to celebrate.
items.full: The decision made, we went out to celebrate.

items.q: For ______ his talent, he never became famous.
items.full: For all his talent, he never became famous.
No matter what happens, stay calm.

items.q: Try as I ______, I couldn't remember her name.
items.full: Try as I might, I couldn't remember her name.

items.q: Decidas lo que decidas, te apoyo.
items.a: Whatever you decide, I'll support you.

items.q: Por mucho que lo intente, no lo consigo.
items.a: However hard I try, I can't do it.

items.q: Si el tiempo lo permite, saldremos a navegar.
A pesar de todo su dinero, no es feliz.
items.a: For all his money, he isn't happy.
